name: SpatialTree-Bench
description: SpatialTree-Bench evaluates methods for recovering and analyzing spatial hierarchical structure in tissue/biological images and spatial-omics data. It measures model performance on tasks such as spatial segmentation, localization of spatial domains, and reconstruction of spatial relationships. The benchmark emphasizes robustness across resolutions and tissue types relevant to spatial biology research.
evaluation_method: F1 (and spatial/topological similarity metrics where applicable)
reputation: A recent dataset aimed at spatial biology and computational pathology researchers; modest adoption so far within that community.
